# `surfaces/RenderSurfaceMaterial.js`

> **Source:** `engine/surfaces/RenderSurfaceMaterial.js`

engine/surfaces/RenderSurfaceMaterial.js — bind a RenderSurface onto a mesh as baseColor or emissive, in world- or screen-space, reusing the EngineMaterial schema so surfaces flow through the same material/binding path as imported textures. The GPU resource accessor lets any renderer drop the surface's live texture into a bind group without knowing how it is produced.

## Functions

### `createSurfaceMaterial(surface, opts = {})`

Create an EngineMaterial that samples a RenderSurface. Screens usually want the UNLIT workflow + the EMISSIVE slot (they emit their own light) so they stay bright regardless of scene lighting.

**Parameters:**

- `surface` *(object)* — RenderSurface
- `[opts]` *(object)* — { slot, space, unlit, emissiveStrength, name }

**Returns:** EngineMaterial (with a `.surface` binding block)

### `surfaceTextureResource(surface)`

Live GPU resource for a surface, for inserting into a bind group.

**Returns:** |null} null until first upload

### `materialSurfaceBinding(material)`

Is this material backed by a render surface? Returns its binding block or null.

### `surfaceIdFromTextureId(textureId)`

Map a virtual surface texture id (`surface://id`) back to the surface id.

## Constants

- `SURFACE_SLOT`
- `SURFACE_SPACE`
